verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs and pricing page describe drop-in prebuilt UIs for sign-up, sign-in, and user profile, including `<SignIn/>`, `<SignUp/>`, a user dropdown, and profile/security settings. The docs also say these components can be customized to match branding with any CSS library, and the GitHub repo confirms the sign-up, sign-in, and profile-management focus. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of hosted/redirect auth pages (only 'deploy to your own domain' is mentioned), and independent hands-on corroboration of production-grade UI customization.
